entries.camera: Extreme macro close-up at hand height, 85mm look, very shallow depth of field, the lens slightly below the hand.
entries.subject: A bare open palm, fingers spread, pressed flat against the flat of a huge falling greatsword blade at the instant of impact: the steel bursts outward into a slow-motion spray of glittering shards and a circular shockwave ripples through the dust from the palm. Only the forearm and wrist of the monk are visible, cropped at the elbow, in plain linen hand wraps with no jewellery. Behind, the blurred grey stone courtyard of a mountain monastery, with petals and dust thrown up by the shockwave.

entries.camera: Long, low, one-point-perspective view down a torch-lit stone corridor from behind the figure, wide lens, the figure occupying about a quarter of the frame height.
entries.subject: A hooded figure seen from behind, one shoulder already dissolving into the black of the corridor wall. The figure's shadow has detached from the floor and stands upright a step ahead of them, stepping into the next patch of darkness while the real figure is still mid-stride. Torches along the corridor gutter, each throwing a pool of cold light that the shadow avoids.
entries.accent: deep indigo-violet shadow with a thin line of cold silver moonlight

entries.camera: Wide low-angle hero shot from the foot of a stone pillar looking up, wide lens, the figure small against a huge sky.
entries.subject: A lone monk, seen from behind and below as a dark silhouette, balanced on top of a weathered stone pillar over a storm-lashed gorge, arms spread. Four streams spiral around the arms and body, each lit by its own element: a ribbon of fire, a coil of water, drifting shards of rock and a whirl of torn cloud and wind. Lightning flickers in the clouds behind.
entries.accent: each element in its own colour — orange fire, teal water, grey-brown stone, white wind

entries.camera: Medium close-up at table height, 50mm, a lantern-lit night scene, the interior of a quiet infirmary tent softly blurred behind.
entries.subject: A masked healer seen from the side and slightly behind, face hidden by a plain featureless white ceramic half-mask, bending over a low table. Both hands are cupped around a small clay bowl of steaming herbal remedy; a soft healing glow rises from it in drifting motes of light that gather around the fingers. On the table beside the bowl: a lantern, bundles of dried herbs, small stoppered vials, rolled clean bandages and a mortar with a pestle. Behind, rows of empty cots with folded blankets in a calm, softly lit infirmary. A calm, peaceful scene.
entries.accent: warm healing green with a soft lantern gold

entries.camera: Straight-down overhead view, symmetrical, wide lens, the darkest part of the floor at the bottom of the frame.
entries.subject: Looking straight down at a kneeling figure in dark robes at the centre of a round stone chamber, one palm pressed flat on the flagstones. From the palm a wave of death spreads outward in a perfect ring: near the figure the flowers and moss between the flagstones are grey, curled and crumbling to dust; further out they are still green and in bloom, the wave frozen mid-spread, with pale mist rising along its edge. The floor mosaic around is carved with skull motifs.
entries.accent: cold necrotic grey with a pale sickly light

entries.camera: Side-on horizontal close-up at table level, very shallow depth of field, the blade in sharp focus running across the frame.
entries.subject: A straight longsword drawn halfway out of a plain black scabbard, resting on a low lacquered table, a single thin line of light running along the whole edge of the blade. Beside it a calligraphy brush lies across an ink stone with one drop of black ink about to fall. A hand cropped at the wrist rests on the hilt, knuckles scarred, a single red silk tassel hanging from the pommel. Behind, the paper screens of a dojo glow with dawn.
entries.accent: cool steel-blue with a single crimson tassel

entries.camera: Canted (dutch-angle) low-angle action shot from the floor, wide lens, frozen at a high shutter speed.
entries.subject: In a crowded candle-lit tavern a figure leans impossibly far backwards in what looks like a stumble but is a dodge, one foot on a table edge, seen from behind and the side with the face turned away. A wine gourd tipped in one hand pours a perfect arc of red wine, droplets frozen in the air, while a thrown tankard and a spinning wooden stool fly past exactly where the figure's chest was. Toppled stools and startled silhouettes of patrons fill the background.
entries.accent: wine red and warm candle gold

entries.camera: Extreme wide shot from behind and slightly below, the figure tiny on a stone terrace, strongly backlit, enormous depth.
entries.subject: At sunrise on the highest terrace of a cliff monastery, a small silhouetted monk stands with one arm extended. From the open palm a long lance of pure sunlight blasts across the valley, tearing the morning mist apart and lighting the far peaks and the tiled roofs below. Streamers of mist and a few startled birds are caught in the beam.
entries.accent: blazing white-gold sunlight against deep blue shadow

entries.camera: Low-angle symmetrical wide shot looking up from the floor of a dark temple hall.
entries.subject: A monk kneels in meditation on a stone dais, seen from behind. Rising from the monk, vast and translucent, an astral being made of pale light: a tall torso with four enormous arms raised in a calm guard, a blank mask-like face tilted slightly down, its edges dissolving into stardust. The temple pillars and floor are lit only by it.

entries.camera: Over-the-shoulder view from behind and above at a cliff edge, looking out and down over a sea of clouds, a strong sense of height.
entries.subject: A figure in plain monk's wraps crouches at the very edge of a cliff, seen from behind. A pair of vast translucent draconic wings of light unfurl from the figure's back, the membranes veined with glowing embers and the surface rippling like scales. Ahead of the figure a roaring cone of dragonfire scours the clouds below, throwing light back across the wings.
entries.accent: deep ruby-red dragonfire with gold edges

entries.camera: Close side-on three-quarter freeze-frame, the fist in the foreground, shallow depth of field.
entries.subject: A fist wrapped in linen hand wraps that glow with abstract geometric patterns — no legible writing — punches through a pane of floating arcane light shaped like a spell circle, which shatters into hexagonal shards. Behind it the open palm of the other hand holds a small hovering orb. Only the hands and forearms are visible, cropped at the elbows. The background is a dim training hall full of slowly floating books, out of focus.
